Deploy a Cursor App to Production: the Localhost Trap

Quick thread 🧵
Push your repo to GitHub, launch a Node server, connect the repo, and set your port, build, and start commands.
Before that, fix what localhost was covering for: a hard-coded port, a SQLite file, secrets read from a `.env`, and uploads written to local disk.
The cleanup is the actual work, and it's maybe twenty minutes.
